GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Rider reported that his mount hung out making the home turn and did not feel entirely comfortable in its action. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the horse to have a poor post-race recovery. Trainer was advised that a veterinary clearance will be required for the horse prior to being permitted to barrier trial or race again.
